text:
Alex: Heads up — canary deploy of merge 43f2d triggered a p95 latency spike on the serving runtime. KV cache miss rate on canaries jumped ~18%.

Maria: link to grafana -> https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc/runtime-canary?orgId=1&panel=5 :eyes:

Alex: snapshot: p95 went from ~42ms -> ~210ms, tail latency and CPU both climbed. Throughput stayed flat.

ci-bot: perf-ci: post-merge perf-check FAILED for job runtime-regression (p95 +168ms, kv_miss +18%). See /ci/jobs/7692

Kevin: Interesting — new kernel-selector heuristic from runtime/kernel-heuristic changed scoring for small batches. Might flip to 'fast-attn-v2' more often which increases kernel churn.

Leah: I can repro locally with a short harness. Command: 
```
./tools/perf_harness.sh --model=gptx-small --seq=1024 --batch-dist=bursty --duration=300 --collect-kv-stats
```
Local run shows kv_miss 12% -> 30% after enabling selector change.

ops-bot: staged-rollout-bot: CANARY PAUSED automatically by sentinel (p95 threshold 100ms breached).

Maria: We should bisect commits between last-green and this merge. @Kevin can you try bisecting with kernel-selector toggles?

Kevin: Starting quick bisect now — will toggle the heuristic flag and run the perf harness on a small canary set.

Kevin: Bisect result: root cause points to commit 4a9b2 in runtime/kernel-heuristic (adjusted batching window and kernel score weights). Reproduces reliably on canary. Flamegraph: https://perf.redwood/internal/fg/4a9b2 (shows added stack switching overhead).

Alex: If I force the selector to fallback to the previous scoring, p95 returns to baseline and kv_miss drops back to normal. Two options: revert 4a9b2 or add a rollout guard to force stable kernel selection for canaries.

Leah: I'll add a CI synthetic test that mimics the long-tail seq distribution and asserts kv_miss delta < 5% vs baseline. Patch coming in PR.

Maria: Proposal for auto-rollback sentinel: abort rollout if canary p95 > 1.5x baseline OR kv_miss increase > 10% sustained for 5 minutes. Also add a metric for kernel-switch-rate to the gating rules. Thoughts?

Kevin: +1. Also add a feature flag kernel_prefer_stable=true during staged rollouts so the selector prefers the known-good kernel until the canary passes extra perf checks.

Alex: I opened issue RED-8912 and PR RED-8920 (adds gate + CI test + feature flag). https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-8912

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary roll paused and rollback initiated to tag release-1.4.2.

sre-oncall: Silenced noisy alerts, monitoring cluster while rollback completes. Will re-run harness after rollback to validate.

Maria: After rollback, let's schedule a short postmortem and a follow-up to harden kernel heuristics with unit/regression tests. :+1:

Alex: Agreed. Thanks everyone for the quick triage.
